confirm_raw_n2_draw1.name: confirm_raw_n2_draw1

chunk_protocol.note: One seven-chunk partition, same exact calibration/header and same 98 previously evaluated recordings. Seven calls are not seven new recording cohorts.

t12_exact_repeats.note: The same within-block label permutation is shared across all calls, preserving their dependence. Assumes label exchangeability within blocks; not population inference.

t16_frozen_n7.note: The same within-block label permutation is shared across all calls, preserving their dependence. Assumes label exchangeability within blocks; not population inference.

uncertainty_policy: Report unique recordings, per-call/per-block outcomes, calibration-draw spread, and descriptive trial intervals separately. Never pool repeated predictions as independent trials or infer population performance from two participants.
